summary: IMPORT verification of RealAICoach into Emergent template. Backend (FastAPI, 3417 routes) and frontend (Expo web on Metro:3000) both boot cleanly. All 7 backend bring-up tests PASS (health, register+login of a fresh user, admin login, /api/auth/me, /api/openapi.json admin-gated behavior, admin roles). Frontend end-to-end verified: landing page loads with expected nav/CTA, admin login via /auth/login succeeds (session_token cookie set, /api/auth/me returns admin identity with is_admin=true and roles [admin,premium,user]), post-login redirects to the authenticated Home/dashboard (Welcome back, Admin), and public /pricing and /features pages render without crashes. Note: after clicking SIGN IN, a 'Would you like to use biometric login?' modal appears and must be dismissed (Not now) before the client-side redirect completes — this is not a bug but is worth flagging.

integration_issues.issue: After successful login, a 'Would you like to use biometric login?' modal blocks the automatic redirect to Home until the user clicks 'Not now' or 'Enable now'. Test automation and users who don't dismiss this may perceive the app as 'still on /auth/login'. Session is fully established (cookie + /api/auth/me 200) before the modal appears — so this is a UX/observation, not a functional bug. Consider auto-redirecting behind the modal or defaulting to 'Not now'.

On every anon page load, the app performs GET /api/auth/me and receives 401 (expected — logs warning [auth-session] auth_me_unauthorized). This is expected behavior for cookie-only auth bootstrapping but adds a red 401 to devtools console. Not a defect.

action_items: None required for import verification — app boots and core flows work. Optional UX: consider deferring the biometric-enrollment prompt or auto-continuing behind it so post-login navigation is uninterrupted.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py has a self-heal env pattern and app factory — booted fine on fresh empty MongoDB (test_database).
Auth uses httpOnly session_token cookie (JWT). No bearer token in login body — matches spec in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
/api/openapi.json and /api/docs are correctly admin-gated (401 anon, 200 admin). This is by-design and verified.

Two React require-cycles logged as warnings: src/components/AppShell.tsx <-> src/components/GlobalNavBar.tsx (and via CommandPalette). These are pre-existing in the imported code and non-blocking, but flagged for future refactor.
'useNativeDriver is not supported' warning on the web build — expected for Expo web; non-blocking.
'textShadow*' style props deprecation warning — cosmetic; non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (landing, admin sign-in, authenticated dashboard, /pricing, /features all rendered without crash)
